predecessors.name: Western Chalukya Empire
predecessors.text: the Lata region of southern Gujarat, which the dynasty 'ruled' as feudatories of the Western Chalukyas 'in their early years'

successors.name: Chaulukya dynasty
successors.text: Lata, which Karna annexed 'by 1074 CE'; the dynasty 'appears to have been vanquished by the Chaulukyas of Gujarat'

ledger.x: c. 970: the Lata Chalukyas appear in southern Gujarat. Infobox 'Established: c. 970 CE'; they 'ruled the Lata region of present-day Gujarat during 10th and 11th centuries' and, 'in their early years', as feudatories of the Western Chalukyas; Barappa is the first ruler (c. 970-990). The page names no boundary and no…

c. 1009 (bridge): Kirtiraja takes Lata back. 'Kirtiraja regained control of the region within a short time, before being defeated by the Paramara king Bhoja' after Durlabharaja defeated him c. 1008 ('He invaded the Lata region, and defeated the Lata Chalukya ruler Kirtiraja (or Kirtipala)'). The page dates neither the…

c. 1018: Bhoja subjugates the Chalukyas of Lata. 'Bhoja's first military aggression appears to be his invasion of the Lata region' (around 1018 CE); 'Bhoja subjugated the Chalukyas of Lata, whose ruler Kirtiraja may have served as his feudatory for a brief period.' The Bhoja page gives no later word on Lata.

c. 1070: the Lata Chalukya line ends. Infobox 'Disestablished: c. 1070 CE'; 'by 1074 CE, the dynasty appears to have been vanquished by the Chaulukyas of Gujarat'. The dynasty holds no land on the map after 1018 (Paramara, then Kalachuri, then Chaulukya 1074 in the other ledgers), so nothing changes hands in this year.

wars.name: Durlabharaja's invasion of Lata
wars.outcome: Durlabharaja defeats the Lata Chalukya ruler Kirtiraja c.

wars.name: Bhoja's invasion of Lata
wars.outcome: Bhoja subjugates the Chalukyas of Lata around 1018; Kirtiraja 'may have served as his feudatory for a brief period'.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier of the Lata Chalukyas; Lata is the shared region of the Chaulukya, Paramara and Western Chalukya ledgers.
